observations: Photo 0: Front view of a Canon DSLR body with 'Canon' and '800' (partially obscured by cap) visible on top plate; 18-55mm lens attached, lens cap on.

Photo 1: Rear view of the same camera, articulating screen closed/flipped, viewfinder visible, control dials visible (MENU, INFO, WB, AF buttons) - a small antenna-like accessory appears to be propped against a nearby shelf, unrelated to the camera.

Photo 2: Front view again with lens cap removed, showing 'Canon EOS 800D' text clearly on top plate, and the lens front element and zoom markings (18-24-35-55mm) visible; no close-up of glass clarity.
Background shows a shop shelf with other camera boxes (Nikon D7000, Canon 4000D) and cameras, suggesting a dealer stall rather than a private seller.
No photo shows the camera powered on, a shutter count screen, battery, charger, or any accessory separately.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Model name '800D' is visible in photo 2, but 'UK used' origin and overall condition claim cannot be confirmed from photos alone.
No screenshot of shutter count (e.g. via EOSInfo or similar tool) is shown in any photo.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows the front lens element but at a distance and angle insufficient to rule out fungus or fine scratches; no macro or backlit shot provided.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: No photo shows the battery, charger, or any internal/service marks.

risks.risk: Actual shutter count may be much higher than claimed, affecting mechanical lifespan and value.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a tool like EOSInfo, ShutterCount, or the camera's own menu/firmware screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a high-shutter-count/heavily used body

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus, haze, or scratches not visible at this photo distance.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens held up to a light source showing the front and rear elements clearly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a lens defect (haze/fungus)

risks.risk: Sensor may have dust, scratches, or stuck pixels affecting image quality.
risks.proof: A sample photo taken with the camera at a small aperture (e.g. f/16) against a plain white background, or a direct photo of the sensor.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or the shutter mechanism may be faulty despite being displayed.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the camera powering on, focusing, and firing the shutter.

risks.risk: Battery and charger may not be original Canon parts, or may be missing/faulty.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery and charger showing Canon branding and model numbers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as if battery/charger are generic or missing

risks.risk: LCD screen or viewfinder could have defects (dead pixels, cracks) not visible from these angles.
risks.proof: A photo of the screen powered on displaying a live menu or image, and a close-up of the viewfinder.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a screen/viewfinder defect

proof_requests: Photo/screenshot of the shutter count from the camera's diagnostic menu or a shutter-count tool.
Close-up, backlit photo of the lens front and rear elements to check for fungus, haze, or scratches.
Short video of the camera powering on, focusing, and taking a shot.
Photo of the battery and charger with visible Canon branding.
A sample image taken with the camera to check sensor cleanliness and lens sharpness.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Canon EOS 800D DSLR with an 18-55mm kit lens from the visible model text and lens markings, but none of the seller's condition claims (shutter count, lens clarity, originality of battery/charger, working state) are verifiable from the photos, so it must be priced at worst case against comparable entry/mid-range Canon DSLRs of similar class.
